name: OBS Studio
description: Record and stream with OBS Studio: sources, audio, recording settings, scenes and the Controls dock.
notes: Qt accessibility exposes the menu bar, dock buttons, dialogs and most settings controls; the preview is a video surface with no tree. The Sources and Scenes add buttons show only a plus icon, so their accessible names are unverified and lessons fall back to the dock region. Bridge checks map to obs-websocket v5 requests (GetRecordStatus, GetInputList, GetCurrentProgramScene, GetRecordDirectory) and need the WebSocket server switched on under Tools.
